I develop R packages. Source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki); most are on [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/) and [r-universe](https://uchidamizuki.r-universe.dev).

## Input–output analysis

- [**econio**](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki/econio) — input–output analysis
- [**econiodatajp**](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki/econiodatajp) — ready-to-use Japanese input–output tables
- [**econioread**](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki/econioread) — read input–output tables
- [**econagent**](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki/econagent) — utility functions and composite goods in economics
- [**ndgras**](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki/ndgras) — the nD-GRAS method (a multidimensional extension of RAS)

## Japanese official statistics & geospatial data

- [**jpstat**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=jpstat) — tools for easy use of the e-Stat API
- [**jpcity**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=jpcity) — read and convert Japanese municipality codes
- [**jpgrid**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=jpgrid) — functions for the Grid Square Codes (JIS X 0410)
- [**jpmap**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=jpmap) — Japan maps with insets for Okinawa and Ogasawara

## Data structures & tooling

- [**dibble**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=dibble) — dimensional data frames
- [**timbr**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=timbr) — forest / tree data frames
- [**stickyr**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=stickyr) — data frames with persistent columns and attributes
- [**adverbial**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=adverbial) — enhanced partialised and composed functions
- [**navigatr**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=navigatr) — navigation menu for pipe-friendly data processing
- [**tarchives**](https://cran.r-project.org/package=tarchives) — make your `targets` pipelines into a package
